hooks.command:
cmd=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"].get("command",""))' | tr '
' ' '); [ -d ./Prompts ] && printf '%s
' "$cmd" | grep -qE ' (Rscript|R45|python3?|ipython|snakemake|make) | (bash|sh) +[^ ]+\.(sh|bash) |\./[^ ]+\.(sh|R|r|py|Rmd) ' && { mkdir -p ./Prompts/Logs; printf -- '- %s — `%s`
' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" "$cmd" >> ./Prompts/Logs/RUN_LOG.md; } || true
